nodes.description: uint256 public maxSupply = 5555; hard cap on total token supply used by mint and _getTokenToBeMinted.
uint256 public constant price = 0.009 ether; per-token mint price used in msg.value check.
uint256 public constant maxMintAmount = 20; per-transaction mint cap.
bool public active = false; sale gate toggled by setActive and read by mint.
mapping(uint16 => uint16) private tokenMatrix; pseudo-random-to-tokenId swap table used by _getTokenToBeMinted.
address private _owner in Ownable; returned by owner() and mutated by transferOwnership/_setOwner.
mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; ERC721 balances mutated by _mint, _transfer and _burn.
mapping(uint256 => address) private _owners; ERC721 token ownership map mutated by _mint, _transfer and _burn.
public payable mint(uint256 amount): checks active/maxMintAmount/price/maxSupply then loops _safeMint with pseudo-random token ids.
public onlyOwner withdraw(): reads contract balance and pushes it to msg.sender via low-level send.
public onlyOwner setActive(bool _active): toggles the sale flag active.
modifier onlyOwner: require(owner() == _msgSender()); access-control choke point for privileged functions.
public virtual onlyOwner transferOwnership(address newOwner): replaces _owner after zero-address check.
internal _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId): calls _mint then _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient.
private _checkOnERC721Received: if recipient is a contract, performs an external try/catch call to onERC721Received (reentrancy surface).
private _getTokenToBeMinted(uint16 _totalMintedTokens): picks a pseudo-random index via getRandomNumber and swaps entries in tokenMatrix.
library getRandomNumber(uint16 _upper, uint16 _totalMintedTokens): keccak256 over blockhash, coinbase, difficulty and msg.sender, modulo _upper.
public view tokenURI(uint256 tokenId): builds base64 metadata from on-chain derived traits and block.number animation location.
internal _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId): updates _balances and _owners after ownership checks and approval clearing.
internal _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId): increments _balances[to] and writes _owners[tokenId].
public view owner(): returns the _owner state variable used by the onlyOwner check.
External caller address (_msgSender()): mint recipient, withdraw recipient and randomness seed component.
Low-level value transfer in withdraw(): require(payable(msg.sender).send(balance)) forwards the whole balance to a caller-controlled address.
Predictable/manipulable on-chain randomness source in getRandomNumber feeding token id selection.
External callback executed on the recipient contract during _safeMint before the mint loop completes.
uint256 amount parameter of mint().
bool _active parameter of setActive().
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership().
uint16 _totalMintedTokens parameter of _getTokenToBeMinted().
uint16 _upper parameter of getRandomNumber() used as the modulo bound.
uint256 tokenId parameter of tokenURI().
address to parameter of _safeMint(), the mint recipient.
local uint256 supply = totalSupply() cached in mint().
local uint16 tmpTotalMintedTokens loop counter in mint().
local uint256 balance = address(this).balance in withdraw().
local uint16 maxIndex = uint16(maxSupply - totalSupply()) in _getTokenToBeMinted().
local uint16 random index returned by getRandomNumber in _getTokenToBeMinted().
local uint16 tokenId resolved from tokenMatrix in _getTokenToBeMinted().
local uint16 rand in getRandomNumber() computing the pseudo-random word.

edges.reason: mint reads maxSupply to bound supply + amount.
mint compares amount against maxMintAmount to limit batch size.
mint is gated by the owner-controlled active flag.
mint computes price * amount and requires msg.value >= that product.
mint caches totalSupply() into local supply.
supply + amount is compared to maxSupply, an additive bound check.
mint initializes tmpTotalMintedTokens from supply before the loop.
mint calls _safeMint once per requested token inside the loop.
mint passes _msgSender() as the _safeMint recipient, i.e. a caller-controlled address receives tokens.
mint calls _getTokenToBeMinted to obtain each token id.
_getTokenToBeMinted reads and writes the tokenMatrix swap table.
_getTokenToBeMinted calls getRandomNumber to pick the index.
_getTokenToBeMinted derives local maxIndex from remaining supply.
_getTokenToBeMinted stores the getRandomNumber result in local random.
_getTokenToBeMinted resolves the final tokenId from tokenMatrix.
_getTokenToBeMinted uses maxSupply when computing maxIndex.
getRandomNumber hashes blockhash/coinbase/difficulty/msg.sender, an unsafe randomness source.
msg.sender is part of the getRandomNumber seed, making it caller-influenced.
_safeMint first calls _mint to create the token.
_safeMint then calls _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external call to onERC721Received on an attacker-supplied contract, allowing reentrancy during minting.
_mint increments _balances[to] by 1.
_mint writes the owner into _owners[tokenId].
_transfer decrements and increments _balances entries.
_transfer updates _owners[tokenId] to the new owner.
withdraw is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw caches address(this).balance in local balance.
withdraw forwards the whole balance to msg.sender using a low-level send, an external call before finalization.
the recipient of the withdraw send is the caller-controlled address msg.sender.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender().
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner checks _msgSender() against the stored owner.
setActive is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
setActive writes the owner-controlled active gate.
setActive assigns the _active parameter to state.
transferOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership rewrites the privileged _owner state variable.
transferOwnership uses the newOwner parameter as the new owner.
tokenURI derives metadata from the supplied tokenId parameter.
mint uses the amount parameter to control the mint loop.
the amount parameter is the external input driving mint's loop and payment checks.
the _active parameter is consumed by setActive.
the newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
_totalMintedTokens seeds randomness inside _getTokenToBeMinted.
_upper bounds the modulo applied to the random word in getRandomNumber.
tokenId parameter is consumed by tokenURI.
to parameter is the recipient used by _safeMint.
tmpTotalMintedTokens is the loop counter inside mint.
local rand holds the truncated keccak256 word in getRandomNumber.
